_comment: BMSIT CSE-10 demo. Real timetable structure as transcribed by the team (notice-board photos, 23 Nov 2026); simulated leave and eligibility. Placeholder names. Every item says where it comes from in _basis. No attendance: there is no official source. Choose it with TARS_SEED=bmsit.
_limits: One teacher is stored per class: co-faculty look free, and their availability elsewhere is not verified.
F_SMP is a demo assumption for all 1BAI103 classes; nothing enforces Thursday only.
F_GPL is the only listed PLC LAB cover; if they decline, the decision escalates.

CSE-10 THU P5 is neither confirmed nor free: the poster is blank there and F_GPL's note is unclear. It is stored as a busy, labelled UNCONFIRMED-PLC class; TARS proposes nothing into it and never moves or substitutes it.
Saturdays are left out; holidays are not modelled.
Lab classes are never proposed for a move with TARS_SEED=bmsit. Moves of other classes are still possible and the HOD must check them.
Rejected proposals are not remembered: reporting the same absence again can propose the same move.
Two-period labs are two one-period classes.
Other classes of F_CDB and F_GPL are stored only as BUSY- sections.
